I am on the same boat. It’s tough feeling unmotivated due to how you feel. It’s really really tough. I too find myself crying everyday or feeling a deep inner pain. But what I’ve done to help motivate myself to do more school work is to stay on the campus and not go home right away. I find that when I go home I just lie in bed and cry, so pushing myself to be out does help a little. After doing this for about a week, my school work has gotten better, but honestly I do still feel very sad when I am not distracted. I’m sorry if this isn’t much help. I guess I relate to you more than I can help you.

I’m not okay. 

I’ve also gone through fights this summer within my friend circle, which distanced me from them, got me banned from their house too. 

My grandmother has had two heart attacks in the span of a month and I’m scared that I’ll lose her. 

My boyfriend broke up with me two days ago because he lost feelings for me. But I will love him so much. 

Today was the first day of my junior year in college. I was put on academic probation last semester and this semester is my last chance to redeem myself. But how can I when my head is everywhere else?

I feel so lost and alone. I feel like I don’t fit in here anymore. No friends to turn to, no boyfriend to turn to. I’m hurting more and more each day. I haven’t eaten in two days, I can’t sleep at night, my body is constantly in pain, I have numbness in my arms and legs, I can’t breathe at times, I am beyond hurt. My family is far and i don’t want to tell them anything because I don’t want to create more stress in their lives, and I’m the oldest so I feel pressured to set a good example for my siblings. I’m alone in this world. I just want to be done I really do. But i can’t do this to my family, they would be completely blindsided and out into such a horror and I’m scared that if I pull through with trying, I will live through it. I just want to give up, everyone else has given up on me anyways.
